settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Typed settings registered by each module. A value set for a location overrides its legal entity, which overrides the whole company; without any value the default applies.
settings.effectiveDatedHint: Values take effect from a date and keep their history.
settings.sensitiveHint: Sensitive: stored values are hidden. You can still replace them.

values.title: Stored values
values.empty: No value is stored; the default applies everywhere.
values.removeConfirm: Remove this value? The next less specific level, or the default, applies again.

set.title: Set a value
set.validFromHint: Takes effect on this date (today when empty). The value in force before it ends the day before.
set.notDatedHint: This setting is not dated: the value replaces the current one at this level.
set.done: Value saved. It now resolves to {value} ({source}).

resolve.title: Which value applies?
resolve.hint: Pick a legal entity and / or a location and a date to see the value used there, and where it comes from.

sequences.title: Numbering
sequences.subtitle: Number series for employee numbers, contracts, decisions… Numbers are taken by the modules when a record is created; gap-free series give a number back when the transaction is cancelled.
sequences.previewHint: The number the next record would get. Nothing is consumed.
sequences.codeInvalid: Upper-case letters, digits and '_', starting with a letter (2–41 characters).
sequences.codeHint: Used by the modules to take numbers, e.g. EMPLOYEE_NO. Cannot be changed later.
sequences.patternHint: Tokens: {tokens}. Everything else is kept as typed.

patternProblem.seqWidth: '{SEQ:n}' needs a width n between 1 and 12.

sequences.sampleHint: Number {n} on {date}{le, select, none {} other { for legal entity {le}}}.
sequences.gapFreeHint: The number is taken inside the business transaction and returned if it is cancelled. Off: faster, but cancelled records leave gaps.

errors.invalid-setting-value: The value does not match the setting's type.
errors.level-not-allowed: This setting cannot be set at that level.
errors.unknown-legal-entity: The legal entity does not exist.
errors.sequence-code-taken: A series with this code already exists.
errors.unknown-sequence: The series does not exist or is inactive.
errors.legal-entity-required: This series needs a legal entity.
